answer: Identities pass through a prism: one proof splits into five spectral bands, each countersigned by a distinct peer within 12 hours or the identity earns nothing. A marble registry records every band ever issued, so a clone inherits its parent's band set and is flagged on collision. Nectar rewards drip at 2 units per verified band per epoch, capped at 10 per identity however many clones exist. To farm 100 nectar an attacker needs 50 distinct peers each burning real compute to countersign, while the prism's collision check makes every clone costlier as the registry fills.
